how_to_run: Copy the listed kit folder (or fixture) into an empty scratch folder and give the prompt to a fresh agent with the skill installed; the agent must not see eval-kit/generator/expected/ or the fixtures' defect lists. Serve the result with scripts/preview_server.py, run scripts/audit.mjs and scripts/check_numbers.py, open the screenshots, and grade against expected_output, the expectations, and the trap answers in the answers file. Run the same prompt without the skill as a baseline. All material is fictional and generated by eval-kit/generator (CC0). The set spans project types on purpose: a change that helps one eval and hurts another is overfitting.
